title: Choose the visual world
question: A new hand, built from fresh angles. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Mission Patches
options.lineage: Embroidered space-program mission patches from Florida's Space Coast
options.thesis: Every product is a mission, and each one gets its own embroidered patch, stitched on navy twill.
options.viewport: A big RSL lab patch stitches itself in the hero, thread by thread; three product patches orbit it, each with its mission status and a real link.
options.risk: Sliding toward a summer-camp badge look if the stitching is cartoonish rather than precise.

raised.raise: Absence is designed: Snakedoku's patch is printed as an unstitched outline still waiting for its thread.
One monumental figure: the lab patch fills the hero at near-full height instead of sitting as a small logo.
Deep navy gaps separate sections like open sky between missions.
What's next is shown before it lands: Hunchwell's patch carries its launch window, early 2027.

options.label: Backyard Pool
options.lineage: Florida backyard pools: blue tile, waterline mosaic, painted depth marks
options.thesis: The page is a pool seen from the diving board; your cursor drops ripples, and each product floats in its own lane.
options.viewport: Full-bleed pool water with moving caustics; the headline sits on the deck coping; products are lane markers labeled like depth marks.
options.risk: Ripples echo Ripple Pool so closely that the parent may read as that game's own site.

options.label: Azulejo Hall
options.lineage: Cobalt-on-white tiled station halls, the Spanish tile of old Florida
options.thesis: The lab's story painted in cobalt across a hall of tiles, one framed panel per product.
options.viewport: A wide tile panel shows the lab in cobalt, cutting across the grout seams; the headline sits in a cartouche; products are the next panels down the hall.
options.case: Best blue commitment and clear per-product panels; weaker tie to a modern games and AI lab.
options.risk: Can feel historical or ornamental rather than curious and current.

options.label: Algorave Floor
options.thesis: The page as a live code buffer driving music.
options.viewport: A code buffer at stage scale.
options.case: Loud and nocturnal; the opposite of calm games and plain speech.
options.kept: Show what's next before it lands.

options.label: Seven-Segment
options.case: Red-on-black gadget look; nothing to do with the products or the blue brief.
options.kept: Absence drawn as carefully as presence.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.viewport: A cloud cliff with blue voids.
options.case: Dreamy but vague; the products get lost.

options.label: Linocut Broadside
options.case: Protest energy fights the warm, calm tone; no blue.
options.kept: One monumental figure fills the sheet.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An indie studio home page, done well: wordmark, short headline, three product cards with screenshots.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and subline at left, products in a row of three below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other studio by design.
